workloads.label: R1 between monthly over 2-year daily set
workloads.distribution: DAILY rrule 2024-01-01 x731; between() per calendar month (ADR-021 batch path)
workloads.mem_note: tracemalloc sees Python-level allocs only; native (Rust-side) allocs are invisible to it, favoring the ported side on allocation deltas. rss_kb (child-process peak RSS) covers both sides and is the honest cross-side column. rrule: alloc_b not measured (BENCH_NO_TRACEMALLOC=1); per-datetime tracing distorts query loops ~1000x (measured 0.2ms -> 236ms). RSS is the memory column here.
